ports.note: Area is acquisition context for OSM; file inputs do not require it.

ontology.note: GeoSPARQL geometry, PROV activity and QUDT buffer units. The mode the graph was filtered for is asserted as fw:travelMode on the network entity -- the term reachability already uses for the mode it assumes -- from src/catchments.ts, so it is declared on the release whose definition is that module rather than here. Configuration SHACL is future work.

changes.description: The widget says which published extracts cover this study area and links to them, so finding the file is no longer a separate errand. The catalogue is Geofabrik's own index, taken at build time and dated, because that host serves neither its index nor its files with a CORS header -- which also means the download is the browser's own: nothing passes through this application, and the file lands on the practitioner's computer where every province after the first can use it. Extracts are matched geographically, smallest first, so Soho is offered Greater London before England and a study area straddling a border is told no single country covers it rather than being offered the neighbour.

evidence.note: Acquisition only; the graph it produces is checked where it is used. The pacing follows the service's own /api/status rather than a client-side guess, measured against OSMnx's behaviour on 2026-10-19.
